s: Mi hem hachayyabim betzitzit ubo d' seipim: nashim vaabadim — peturim mitztzitzit, apillu mitlabbeshim betallit sheyyesh bah arba kenapot — en tzarik lehatil bah tzitzit, mippene shemmitzvat tzitzit hi mitzvat aseh shehazzeman gerama, shehare kesut layla petura min hatztzitzit, vekol mitzvat aseh shehazzeman gerama nashim vaabadim peturim mimmenna, shenneemar bitpillin: "lemaan tihyeh torat Hashem bepika", huqsha kol hattora kullah litpillin, mah tepillin shehu mitzvat aseh shehazzeman gerama, shehare shabbat veyom tob enan zeman tepillin, venashim vaabadim peturim mehem mittaam sheyyitbaer besiman lach, ap kol mitzvat aseh shehazzeman gerama nashim vaabadim peturim mehem, chutz mimmitzvot peratiyyot sheyyitbaer beezrat hashshem:

Tumtum (shehu atum legamre velo noda im hu zakar o neqeba) veanderoginos (sheyyesh lo zakrut venaqbut) — chayyabim betzitzit missapeq, shemma hem zekarim. Abal en tzerikin lebarek, dispeq berakot lehaqel:

Umikkol maqom, apillu neqebot vaddaim veken abadim im yirtzu lehitattep betzitzit ulebarek — hareshut beyadan, kemo shennohagin bishar mitzvot aseh shehazzeman gerama, vikolin lomar "vetzivvanu lehitattep batztzitzit" ap-al-pi shehen enan metzuvvin, mippene shehaanashim metzuvvim al kak, vegam hen keshemmeqayyemin mitzvot shehem peturim mehem ap-al-pi sheen lahem sakar gadol kimtzuvveh veoseh, mikkol maqom qetzat sakar yesh lahem, laken yekolot hen lebarek al kol mitzvot shehen peturin mehem, im osin hammitzvot ketiqqunan beinyan shehaanashim yekolim lebarek alehem. Umikkol maqom hoil umecheze keyuhara — en lahem lehitlabbesh betzitzit, kevan degam haanashim enam chayyabim bemitzva zo ella im ken yesh lahem tallit bat arba kenapot, veeno chobat haggup kemo shopar velulab shehannashim nohagot lehachamir al atzman:

Qatan hayyodea lehitattep, kegon sheyyodea lehashlik shette kenapot lepanayv ushette kenapot leacharayv veyodea leechoz hatztzitzit beyado bishat qeriat shema kemo shennohagin — abiv chayyab liqnot lo tallit bat arba kenapot ulehatil bah tzitzit kede lechanneko bemitzvot (veayyen siman kad dezeh enah choba kol kak, abal mikkol maqom abiv chayyab lehatil tzitzit lekol beged sheyyesh lo arba kenapot shehabben mitlabbesh bo, kevan shekkebar higgia lechinnuk):
